title: Fire Stopping – Penetration Seals
activity: Batts, sealant joints, collars and wraps
status: Draft spot check from ITPs – for agreement

location.areaHint: e.g. Corridor wall E1, riser R2

questions.q: Seal matches the benchmark for this seal type?
Are service-to-service and service-to-edge spacings within the CLM table? Use the Spacing guide.
Are services clear of the 200 mm door head zone and the critical stud zones?
Is the seal type right for the opening (FSI tight to soffit, Quelfire where services are ≥100 mm below soffit)?
Is the batt tight around every service and sealed on both sides, with no gaps?
Are sealant joints to depth (2:1 ratio) and within tested width limits?
Are collars and wraps the right type for the pipe and fitted to the tested detail?
CLM operative on site has their FIRAS card?
